newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia right-wing fighters threaten UN workers.
newsitem.headline: Colombia right-wing fighters threaten UN workers.

text.p: A right-wing paramilitary group forced a human rights commission, including two U.N. delegates, to leave a region of northwest Colombia under threat of death, church sources said on Tuesday.

The group was investigating reports of rights violations around the town of Vigia del Fuerte in Antioquia province on Monday when it received a note signed by the so-called Peasant Self-Defence Group of Cordoba and Uraba (ACCU), the country's most-feared death squad.

"The note was handed in at the hotel where we're staying and said 'You have 12 hours to leave town or we will blow you all up'," Bishop Jorge Castro, who was travelling with the commission, told the Caracol radio network.

A spokeswoman at the offices of the U.N. High Commission for Human Rights in Bogota, which opened in April, declined comment on the incident except to say: "Two of our experts were in that region yesterday."
In a separate incident in northern Cesar province, suspected paramilitary fighters killed four peasants before dawn on Tuesday, taking to 11 the number killed in the area this week, police said.
A police spokesman in provincial capital Valledupar said the victims in the latest attack were dragged out of their homes near the town of Aguas Blancas and shot.
Three people were murdered in similar circumstances in the town of Badillo on Monday and another four were slain in the nearby town of La Paz over the weekend.

"It's possible that this points to an increase in paramilitary violence," the police spokesman said. "There's quite a heavy guerrilla presence in this part of Cesar but I don't think they were behind this (these killings) because the people in this area support them," he added.

Right-wing paramilitary groups launched an offensive earlier this year in a bid to wipe out leftist guerrillas from northern Colombia. The paramilitary groups frequently target civilians suspected of sympathising with the rebels.
A right-wing death squad killed about 30 people in a village in eastern Meta province earlier this month, one of the worst massacres since 1994.
